title: Multiply by 11 in Your Head
summary: For two-digit times 11, put the sum of the digits in the middle.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: 11 means 10 plus 1, and there is a quick pattern for two-digit numbers.
points: 11 means 10 plus 1, and there is a quick pattern for two-digit numbers.

steps.title: The method: Split and add
sentences: Write the two digits 3 and 4 with a gap.
Put their sum in the gap: 3, 3 plus 4 which is 7, and 4.
points: Write the two digits 3 and 4 with a gap.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: If the sum is 10 or more, carry the 1: for 78 times 11 the digits are 7, 15, 8, giving 858.
